source_resources.author: Grant Sanderson (3Blue1Brown)
source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Chapter 3 review: a matrix is a rank-2 tensor
source_resources.license: 3Blue1Brown copyright (all rights reserved); site FAQ permits only short clips under stated conditions
license_restrictions: No video, audio, transcript or frame redistribution permitted
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external linking only. 3Blue1Brown lessons and videos are copyright 3Blue1Brown; the site FAQ allows only short clips under stated conditions, and the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license of the 3b1b/videos repository covers animation code, not the videos. No video, audio, transcript or frames are imported.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Unequaled geometric and visual intuition for vectors, linear transformations, matrix multiplication, and inverses before tensor operations.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Video streaming hosted on YouTube and 3blue1brown.com; may be blocked by regional networks.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Geometric explanations, worked formulas, and coordinate exercises are fully provided as original lesson text.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: MIT OCW 18.06 Linear Algebra (Prof. Gilbert Strang)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Established textbook/lecture approach, strong mathematical rigor alongside 3Blue1Brown visual intuition.
Theoretical determinant-free proof structure is mathematically elegant but less aligned with computational tensor engineering.

source_resources.author: NumPy Developers
source_resources.relevant_timestamp: General broadcasting rules and incompatible-shape errors
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under the NumPy BSD license; no documentation text imported.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Normative definition of broadcasting rules, shape mismatch errors, and implicit axis expansion shared by NumPy, PyTorch, and other tensor frameworks.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Hosted on numpy.org; an installed NumPy ships equivalent pydoc text.

Selected as co-primary for Day 24: normative shape/strides/reshape semantics complementing the broadcasting rules page.
